caseModel.title: Case Model
caseModel.description: CMMN adaptive case-plan definition for a case type: a tree of stages, human tasks and milestones made adaptive through discretionary items and entry/exit sentries. Complements (does not replace) workflowTemplate: a caseType is driven by exactly one of the two, selected via caseType.handlingModel. See openspec/specs/cmmn-adaptive-case/spec.md.

description.title: Description
description.description: Purpose and usage notes for this case model.

caseType.title: Case Type
caseType.description: Reference to the case type this case model belongs to. That caseType's handlingModel MUST be 'cmmn' for this model to be loadable by CaseModelEngine.

lifecycleStatus.title: Lifecycle Status
lifecycleStatus.description: draft = editable, cannot back new cases. published = immutable, can back new cases (one active per caseType). deprecated = immutable, existing cases keep using it.

caseFileItems.title: Case File Items
caseFileItems.description: Named data slots in the case file that sentries can reference (onPart.caseFileItem / ifPart.field).

type.title: Type
type.description: Value type of this case-file item.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text note on what this case-file item represents and how sentries use it.

planItems.title: Plan Items
planItems.description: The case-plan tree: stages (nestable via parentId), human tasks, and milestones. Each item's lifecycle is tracked at runtime in case.casePlanState: the definition here is immutable data.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Stable id, unique within the model, referenced by parentId/children and by sentry onPart.planItem.

type.title: Type
type.description: CMMN plan-item type: 'stage' nests other plan items in a sub-plan, 'humanTask' is completed by a case worker, 'milestone' marks a point-in-time achievement with no work of its own.

name.title: Name
name.description: Display name of this plan item, shown in the case-plan UI.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional free-text explanation of this plan item's purpose.

discretionary.title: Discretionary
discretionary.description: True = an optional item the case worker may choose to enable. False = mandatory, auto-cascades to active once entry criteria are met.

parentId.title: Parent Id
parentId.description: Id of the containing stage plan item, or null/absent for a top-level item.

children.title: Children
children.description: Ids of direct child plan items (stage only). Validated against parentId at load time.

entryCriteria.title: Entry Criteria
entryCriteria.description: Sentries; the item's entry is satisfied when ANY sentry in this array fires. Empty = satisfied as soon as the parent is active.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Stable identifier for this sentry, unique within its entryCriteria/exitCriteria array.

onPart.title: On Part
onPart.description: Event that must occur: either {planItem, standardEvent} or {caseFileItem, caseFileEvent}.

planItem.title: Plan Item
planItem.description: Id of the referenced plan item.

standardEvent.title: Standard Event
standardEvent.description: CMMN standard event on the referenced plan item that satisfies this sentry: 'complete' when it reaches Completed, 'terminate' when it reaches Terminated, 'disable' when it reaches Disabled.

caseFileItem.title: Case File Item
caseFileItem.description: Id of the referenced case-file item.

caseFileEvent.title: Case File Event
caseFileEvent.description: CMMN case-file event on the referenced case-file item that satisfies this sentry: 'set' when the item first receives a value, 'changed' on any subsequent update.

ifPart.title: If Part
ifPart.description: Condition on the case-file data snapshot, same {field, operator, value} shape as Service/Transitions/RequiredFieldGuard.

field.title: Field
field.description: Dot-path into the case-file data snapshot that this condition evaluates, e.g. a caseFileItem id or nested field.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: Comparison operator applied between field and value (same vocabulary as Service/Transitions/RequiredFieldGuard, e.g. 'equals', 'notEquals', 'contains').

value.title: Value
value.description: The value field is compared against using operator. Type depends on the referenced case-file item.

exitCriteria.title: Exit Criteria
exitCriteria.description: Sentries; the item is force-terminated when ANY sentry in this array fires.

id.title: Identifier
id.description: Stable identifier for this sentry, unique within its entryCriteria/exitCriteria array.

onPart.title: On Part
onPart.description: Event that must occur: either {planItem, standardEvent} or {caseFileItem, caseFileEvent}.

planItem.title: Plan Item
planItem.description: Id of the referenced plan item.

standardEvent.title: Standard Event
standardEvent.description: CMMN standard event on the referenced plan item that satisfies this sentry: 'complete' when it reaches Completed, 'terminate' when it reaches Terminated, 'disable' when it reaches Disabled.

caseFileItem.title: Case File Item
caseFileItem.description: Id of the referenced case-file item.

caseFileEvent.title: Case File Event
caseFileEvent.description: CMMN case-file event on the referenced case-file item that satisfies this sentry: 'set' when the item first receives a value, 'changed' on any subsequent update.

ifPart.title: If Part
ifPart.description: Condition on the case-file data snapshot, same {field, operator, value} shape as Service/Transitions/RequiredFieldGuard.

field.title: Field
field.description: Dot-path into the case-file data snapshot that this condition evaluates, e.g. a caseFileItem id or nested field.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: Comparison operator applied between field and value (same vocabulary as Service/Transitions/RequiredFieldGuard, e.g. 'equals', 'notEquals', 'contains').

value.title: Value
value.description: The value field is compared against using operator. Type depends on the referenced case-file item.

authorization.title: Authorization
authorization.description: Optional list of NC group ids gating the enable/complete/terminate REST actions on this item, same convention as workflowTemplate transition.authorization. Absent/empty = open.
